description: Recognition, Imagination, Will and the Deliberate Construction of a Life — a longitudinal N=1 experiment in consciousness, agency and manifestation.
purpose: Consciousness may possess a greater creative participation in reality than the ordinary model allows. The experiment: if it were true, how should a human being actually live? Every day.

epistemic_registers.B_working_ontology: The metaphysical model provisionally adopted for practice
epistemic_registers.C_phenomenology: What was actually experienced (recorded because it happened, not because interpretation is known)
epistemic_registers.D_outcome: Externally checkable events (income, skills, property, animals, residence)

daily_rule.kriya_block: 60-90 minutes before recreational internet. Every task maps to a target track.
daily_rule.concentration: 3x weekly, 10 min. Hold one image. Restore when it collapses.
daily_rule.dream_incubation: 2 nights/week max. One question. Record immediately on waking.
daily_rule.micro_recognition: 3-5 times/day. 10 seconds. Notice the field. Return to action.

interview_domains: Phenomenology — what changed in visualization, recognition, mood, dreams
Kriyā — what physically happened because you acted
Avoidance — what important action was repeatedly postponed
Belief — what belief produced the week's largest behavioral constraint
Opportunity — what did you notice that earlier versions might have ignored
Anomaly — did anything genuinely surprising occur
Alternative explanation — what is the strongest ordinary explanation
Anticipation — where were you compulsively checking whether it was working
Will — did your desire for the frozen target remain coherent
Bridge — what are next week's three highest-leverage physical moves

event_classifier.C0: Ordinary background event — no plausible relationship
event_classifier.C1: Direct causation — obvious action produced result
event_classifier.C2: Salience-mediated opportunity — goal orientation caused you to notice it
event_classifier.C3: Coincidence — relevant-looking event, no demonstrated causal relation
event_classifier.C4: Pre-registered anomaly — low-base-rate event matching something recorded before
event_classifier.C5: Potentially anomalous information — received in dream/scrying, independently verified

hypotheses.H1_psychological: Imaginal practice → identity → salience → motivation → behavior → changed outcome. No paranormal mechanism required.
hypotheses.H2_inexternalist: Intrinsic phenomenal organization and extrinsic world-involving behavior are aspects of one unfolding process. Changing the aperture changes one side of a world-involving dynamic.
hypotheses.H3_strong: Intentional configuration of consciousness contributes to probability/outcome selection in ways not exhausted by H1/H2. Requires strongest evidence.

master_formula: RECOGNIZE — I am not merely the contracted self-positioning.
INHABIT — Experience it until it possesses phenomenological depth.
LISTEN — Allow unexpected material to emerge.
KNOW — Extract information about the bridge.
ACT — Apply the correct force through the correct medium to the correct object.
RELEASE — Do not demand the route.
OBSERVE — Record what reality actually does.
CORRECT — Change the map, not the evidence.

daily_instantiations: animal is ill and you respond competently

safety_rules: No pacts — no surrender of autonomy to any entity
No lust of result — maximum engagement, minimum insistence
Cassiopaea audit — weekly check for desire/evidence/confusion
Minimum viable day — 3min recognition + 10min bhāvanā + 1 kriyā + 2min logging
Failed day — never compensate, just record MISSED and resume
